answer_review.reasoning: Fold about the vertical midline. In the closed right half, A needs one straight segment at the top fold corner and one at the bottom fold corner; B needs two segments to remove a triangle at the fold edge; C needs one segment at each outer corner; E needs one top outer-corner cut and one bottom fold-corner cut. D has separate off-fold V notches at both top and bottom, each requiring two differently directed cuts: four cuts in all. Therefore only D is impossible with two straight cuts.
